summary: Military aircraft, including fast jets, conducting high energy manoeuvres within 15 nautical miles of Tomintoul, up to 24,500 ft, Monday to Thursday 12:00-20:00.
text:
MIL ACFT, INCLUDING FAST JETS, WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEUVRES
WI 15NM RADIUS OF 571503N 0032241W (TOMINTOUL). ACFT MAY BE
UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR INFO 01343 817218.
AR-2026-11233/01.
